$comment: Contract for the RetireSection server-side command (AD-003, AD-123). Custom API parameter Type codes: 0=Boolean, 10=String.

customApi.name: al_RetireSection
customApi.description: Dates out a section, which removes its questions from the form and the submit gate while the answers they hold keep resolving. Refuses a section holding a question code compiled logic depends on. Enforces Edit on question.retire and writes an immutable Audit Event.

requestParameters.name: SectionId
requestParameters.description: Id of the al_section to retire.

requestParameters.name: EffectiveTo
requestParameters.description: Optional yyyy-MM-dd. Absent is today. May not be in the past.

requestParameters.name: Reason
requestParameters.description: Why the section is no longer part of the checklist. Required and recorded on the Audit Event.

requestParameters.name: IdempotencyKey
requestParameters.description: Stable key for the intent; a replay returns the same result.

responseProperties.name: AuditEventId
responseProperties.description: Id of the Audit Event written.

responseProperties.name: Conflict
responseProperties.description: True when an optimistic-concurrency conflict was detected.
